# Pipeline Case Study and Architecture {#sec-pipeline-case-study}

## Learning objectives

- Define the continuous case study and its trusted output.
- Map sources, processing stages, storage layers, and consumers.
- Establish data contracts and ownership boundaries.

## Case-study flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A["Raw source"] --> B["Extract"]
  B --> C["Validate and transform"]
  C --> D["Trusted dataset"]
  D --> E["Analytics consumer"]
```
